observations.title: Enable integrations by installing their actual owners
observations.player_action: Inspect which FTB and non-FTB mods the bridge detects.
observations.outcome: The bridge has soft dependencies and does nothing useful without supported partner mods.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presence of the bridge is not proof of an integration firing. Confirm detected mods, registered KubeJS event names and installed task/stage ownership before writing scripts.
